author: freeCodeCamp.org
description:
In this Full Stack React Native course, you will learn how to build a complete cross-platform grocery list application from scratch using Expo and React Native. Throughout the lessons, we will integrate modern technologies like Clerk for secure authentication, Neon Postgres with Drizzle ORM for the database, and NativeWind for styling. By the end, you will have the practical skills needed to confidently develop and deploy your own full-stack mobile applications for both iOS and Android.

Course from @codesistency 

Links & resources 👇

To start the project, type this command in your terminal:
👉 npx create-expo-app@latest --template default
